sql: SELECT id FROM (SELECT sluice_src.id, sluice_src.name, CASE WHEN sluice_src.email IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN length(sluice_src.email::varchar) <= ($1 + $3) THEN repeat($2, length(sluice_src.email::varchar)) ELSE concat(substr(sluice_src.email::varchar, 1, $1), repeat($2, (length(sluice_src.email::varchar) - $1) - $3), substr(sluice_src.email::varchar, (length(sluice_src.email::varchar) - $3) + 1)) END AS email, sluice_src.ssn, sluice_src.salary, sluice_src.notes FROM pg.hr.employees sluice_src) employees WHERE email = 'a@b.c'
